correctness.rationale: At the positive equilibrium, the principal diffusion matrix has determinant Q=D1D2-xi1 xi2 b^2/(a+b^2). For Q<0 it has one negative eigenvalue, so the Fourier generator R-|k|^2 D has an eigenvalue c|k|^2+O(1), c>0, yielding unbounded positive-time amplification in every Sobolev space.

originality.rationale: The 2026 source observes a divergent/high-wave-number reciprocal-chemotaxis instability but does not identify it as loss of normal ellipticity or derive Sobolev ill-posedness. Exact-title/identifier and Selkov/chemotaxis/parabolicity/ellipticity searches found no prior source-specific statement; generic cross-diffusion ellipticity facts are not claimed as new.

value.rationale: The result reclassifies a headline infinite-wave-number regime as a continuum well-posedness boundary, clarifies when numerical cutoff modes can masquerade as selected patterns, and supplies a pointwise nonlinear normal-ellipticity criterion.
